```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The variables in the `penguins` dataset are: `r colnames(penguins)`. It includes `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. The mean of `flipper_length_mm` is `r round(mean(pull(drop_na(penguins, flipper_length_mm), flipper_length_mm)),2)` mm.

```{r}
penguins_plot = ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, colour = species)) + geom_point()

ggsave("penguins_scatterplot.png", plot = penguins_plot)
```
